analysis.null_finding: Matched-magnitude shuffled-error null is a 16-sample distribution per organ. Binary and residual reconstructions never separate from that null (frac_separated=0, surplus vs p95 is negative). The 0.8604 bar is therefore being applied to a metric that, on these codecs, cannot tell the reconstruction from a random same-energy perturbation. hgravs01_r160 separates on a minority of organs (gate 0.36 / up 0.44 / down 0.30). This is reported, not papered over.
analysis.fit_set_vs_holdout_note: Scoring the fit set on two screen down organs raises cosine by ~0.03 (L1E265 0.843 holdout vs 0.871 fit-all; L46E428 0.865 vs 0.873). L10E453 fails even fit-on-all at 0.795. The mixed-representation receipt range 0.886-0.898 is not reproduced on these organs.

verdict.reason: No measured recipe — including the packed 1.444 BPW mixed-1p5 artifact and the entire 6x7x7x2 codec grid — clears the 0.8604 bar on all three organs. down_proj is the binding organ (holdout mean 0.768 at hgravs01_r160). Sub-0.655 complete BPW requires leaving the binary family on gate/up and crushes min organ cosine to ~0.69. Bits are reachable; capability is the wall. The campaign should stop pursuing sub-100 fs/weight for Q80 at preserved capability on this architecture.
